# Air quality indicators (fixture, distractor)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

Concentrations of fine particulate matter declined over the decade in most measuring
stations while ozone concentrations remained broadly flat. The report documents
measurement methods, station selection and the treatment of missing values, and it
presents annual means with their uncertainty.
